note: Splide X ships examples for the Splide module: nine demo optionsets (splide.optionset.x_main, x_carousel, x_grid, x_fullscreen, x_overlay, x_split, x_vtabs, x_splide_for, x_splide_nav), image styles, a demo View (views.view.splide_x), and a SplideXSkin plugin (id splide_x_skin). It requires field_image and field_images to exist before install. Medium cases introspect the shipped optionset config; hard cases clone an example optionset and apply an example optionset to a field formatter.

evals.prompt: What does the Splide X submodule provide, and what does its README say you must have before enabling it?
evals.expected_output: Splide X ships example optionsets (x_main, x_carousel, x_grid, x_fullscreen, x_overlay, x_split, x_vtabs, x_splide_for, x_splide_nav), image styles, a demo View (views.view.splide_x), and a SplideXSkin plugin. Its README requires that the image fields field_image (single) and field_images (multi-value) exist before enabling.

evals.prompt: Should I depend on the Splide X module in production, according to its maintainers? What is it for?
evals.expected_output: No; the maintainers recommend cloning the examples into your own module rather than depending on Splide X in production, because it may change. It exists so you can learn from and copy working slider setups (optionsets, image styles, a demo View, a skin).

evals.prompt: What skin plugin does Splide X add, and name a couple of the extra skins it provides?
evals.expected_output: It adds the SplideXSkin @SplideSkin plugin (id splide_x_skin) with extra skins such as d3-back, boxed, rounded, vtabs, and x-testimonial.

evals.prompt: On this Drupal site, name at least one of the example Splide optionsets that the Splide X module installed. Inspect the live configuration to answer.
evals.expected_output: Splide X installed optionsets splide.optionset.x_main, x_carousel, x_grid, x_fullscreen, x_overlay, x_split, x_vtabs, x_splide_for, and x_splide_nav (listable via drush config:status or the splide entity storage).

evals.prompt: On this Drupal site, which skin does the Splide X example optionset x_main use? Inspect the live configuration to answer.
evals.expected_output: x_main uses the 'fullwidth' skin: splide.optionset.x_main skin = fullwidth.

evals.prompt: On this Drupal site, following Splide X's recommendation to clone its examples, create a new Splide optionset with machine id x_clone by copying the shipped x_carousel example optionset. Apply the change to the live site.
evals.expected_output: A splide config entity splide.optionset.x_clone exists whose options.settings.type matches the shipped x_carousel optionset (i.e. it was cloned from x_carousel).

evals.prompt: On this Drupal site, the Article content type has a multi-value image field field_images shown with the plain image formatter. Configure the default view display so field_images renders as a Splide slider using the Splide (splide_image) formatter with the x_carousel optionset that Splide X provides. Apply the change to the live site.
evals.expected_output: In core.entity_view_display.node.article.default the field_images component uses formatter type splide_image with settings.optionset = x_carousel.
